description: What every case table carries beside its cases (specs/README.md, "Case tables"): the rule it states, the consumers that run it, and why an implementation does not yet. A case table's schema extends this one through `allOf` and admits each of its properties.

$comment.description: The rule the table states, in prose.

runBy.description: Each consumer that runs the table, with the consumer-owned test locations that run it.

absent.description: Each implementation that has no counterpart of what the table states, with why.

notYetReached.description: Each implementation that does not run the table yet, with why.

why.description: What the case shows, in prose.

cases.description: The cases, when the table states its rule case by case. The table's own schema states what a case is, and states a case's `why` as this one.
